title: Yarmouth County Museum and Archives

services.name: new exhibits
services.desc: The Yarmouth County Museum has over 20,000 artifacts, both on display and in storage. Along with general collections such as costumes, shoes, ship portraits and musical instruments, we also have an assortment of unique (and often unusual) items of interest. The Yarmouth County Museum's permanent exhibits highlight various aspects of the area's history, going back to its original Mi'kmaq inhabitants, moving forward through different time periods, and expanding to various industries, professions, and specialized displays. As you walk through the museum, each exhibit acts as a window into a different time and place. The Yarmouth County Museum and Archives, owned by the Yarmouth County
